description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a small white drawer unit with an open shelf, and a separate matching drawer piece to the right. The left hand rests on the top edge of the drawer unit to steady it while the right hand grasps the loose drawer, lifts it up and left, and slides it into the open front of the unit until it’s seated, with the left-hand object being the drawer unit and the right-hand object being the drawer.
